decisions.proposed_decision: Add the source Section 4.3 RM#1 digests as a source addendum; scope variants to the frozen supplied-image manifest. Preserve distinct container/media hash scopes. Do not invent acquisition-versus-verification equality.
decisions.remaining_boundary: Need acquisition/verification evidence and selection of supplied RM#3 representation; source hashes alone are not verification.

decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve the printed partition-2 asterisk. Explicitly distinguish MBR active flag, OS-containing partition and boot capability before comparing a Boolean.
decisions.remaining_boundary: Choosing the requested meaning is a contract decision; this review makes no replacement Boolean.

decisions.proposed_decision: Keep the four account rows and printed local-time strings/nulls. Record the display policy and field meanings before converting to UTC.
decisions.remaining_boundary: No one-hour tolerance or offset selected from model/extractor output.

decisions.proposed_decision: Keep all nine applications and printed installation timestamps; define installation field/event semantics and display offset.
decisions.remaining_boundary: Installer execution, registration and completion can be different observations; do not replace one with another.

decisions.proposed_decision: A single expected-row alias may accept singular/plural forms supported by the printed keyword and its URL; all other fields remain required. Declare duplicate/exclusion scope separately.
decisions.remaining_boundary: Alias alone does not settle the source omission of duplicated/meaningless items; extra evidence is not automatically false.

decisions.proposed_decision: Retain both source path statements with their source labels; do not globally equate Office and Outlook directory names.
decisions.remaining_boundary: The physical-container path and registry locator require an artifact-identity decision, not answer fitting.

decisions.proposed_decision: Retain abbreviated paths and source cross-references separately. Treat the ellipsis and registry wildcard as open trace categories, not a closed inventory.
decisions.remaining_boundary: Publish finite path resolution and additional-trace handling before full-question grading.

decisions.proposed_decision: Keep table and quoted-log associations separately. Mechanical epoch arithmetic can be audited, but selecting one association must be an explicit versioned contract decision.
decisions.remaining_boundary: No change to the printed expected associations is included; no answer-key-error claim.

decisions.proposed_decision: Represent the two printed interval endpoints as local minute strings, with explicit printed precision; preserve all11 source rows.
decisions.remaining_boundary: Full question still needs distinctions among host observation, method selection, descriptor timestamp and physical write; patch does not resolve causal meaning or offset.

decisions.proposed_decision: Require six recovered thumbnail artifacts with cache entry locators and a frozen content-identity criterion; titles alone are incomplete.
decisions.remaining_boundary: Need reviewed reference image identity/comparison policy; no LLM judge or automatic title-only full credit.

decisions.proposed_decision: Use the source application context to define logoff as Google Drive sign-out. Preserve the causal wording with attribution, and retain actual VSC/current-system differences.
decisions.remaining_boundary: Finite path identity and the causal-comparison convention still require explicit decisions.

decisions.proposed_decision: Require the17 FAT-directory recovery rows; signature-based carving is optional according to the source. Keep viewability and method fields.
decisions.remaining_boundary: Publish a viewability criterion and optional-output handling. The patch removes no required metadata rows and does not infer viewability from extension/signature.

decisions.proposed_decision: Derive an event-level checklist from Section3 with timestamps/intervals, entities, order and evidence requirements; separate scenario context from disk-recoverable observations.
decisions.remaining_boundary: Daily labels are insufficient; eligibility and detail must be specified without choosing events from an application report.

decisions.proposed_decision: Require an actual portable/renderable diagram and a public content checklist tied to the reviewed timeline; keep any aesthetic assessment separate.
decisions.remaining_boundary: No canonical layout or exact graph is given; a label string is not a diagram.

proposed_patches.public_instruction: The mandatory answer is the metadata-based recovered-file inventory. Signature carving is optional. Keep any carving output in a separately labelled appendix. Viewable means recovered content successfully opens/renders in a compatible viewer; a filename extension or format signature alone is insufficient. Record incomplete or failed rendering as such.
activation_conditions: Agree and freeze the viewability criterion before new submissions.

Apply the same public/private scope to every system; retain the original source-supplemental statements.
